SDDC1.label: Account configuration for download articles

SDDC1.1.label: Account setup issue
SDDC1.1.description: Definition: Use when account permissions or settings prevent the intended article-download process.

SDDC1.2.label: Other
SDDC1.2.description: Definition: Use for another download or transactional-account configuration request.

SDDC1.3.label: Not enough info
SDDC1.3.description: Definition: Use when account configuration is suspected but the required setting is unknown.

SDDC1.description: Every ticket in this task has already been classified as 'Account configuration for download articles'. Choose the root cause from this group only. That contact reason means: Use when the customer asks to configure account-level rules that control article downloads or transactional access, with signals such as download permissions, department access, download limits or pay-per-view settings, and not for failure to open one specific article.
